title: The Comprehensive List of LLM Observability Tools

tools.name: Langfuse
tools.description: Langfuse is a self-hostable LLM engineering platform for traces, sessions, evaluations, prompt management, datasets, annotations, and cost analytics, with hosted deployment also available. Docs

tools.name: Arize AX
tools.description: Arize AX is an enterprise AI observability and evaluation platform for tracing, experiments, online evaluations, drift analysis, and production monitoring across LLM applications and agents.

tools.name: Confident AI
tools.description: Confident AI is the AI quality platform built for enterprise platform teams to standardize evals and observability across the org — one consistent bar for how different product teams measure and monitor their AI.

tools.name: Opik
tools.description: Opik is Comet's open-source tracing and evaluation platform with a hosted service, datasets, experiments, prompt management, online scoring, dashboards, and agent-focused trace views. Docs

tools.name: Helicone
tools.description: Helicone is an open-source observability platform and proxy for logging LLM requests, analyzing sessions, tracking cost and latency, collecting feedback, and running experiments. Docs

tools.name: Laminar
tools.description: Laminar is an open-source platform for tracing, evaluating, and monitoring LLM applications and agents, with OpenTelemetry-based instrumentation, datasets, and browser-agent support. Docs

tools.name: LangSmith
tools.description: LangSmith is LangChain's hosted platform for tracing, debugging, dataset-based evaluation, online evaluators, prompt management, annotation queues, and deployment monitoring across LangChain and non-LangChain applications. Docs

tools.name: Weights & Biases Weave
tools.description: Weights & Biases Weave is an open-source tracing and evaluation toolkit with a managed platform for scorers, datasets, comparisons, prompt iteration, costs, and production monitoring. Docs

tools.name: Braintrust
tools.description: Braintrust is an AI engineering platform for traces, experiments, datasets, prompt iteration, online scoring, user feedback, and production analytics. Docs

tools.name: LangWatch
tools.description: LangWatch is an open-source platform for LLM and agent tracing, evaluations, datasets, prompt optimization, and scenario-based simulation testing. Docs

tools.name: HoneyHive
tools.description: HoneyHive is an AI observability and evaluation platform for tracing, datasets, experiments, online evaluators, human feedback, and production quality monitoring. Docs

tools.name: Galileo
tools.description: Galileo is an enterprise evaluation and observability platform for LLM applications and agents with trace analysis, proprietary evaluators, guardrails, experiments, and production monitoring.

tools.name: Maxim AI
tools.description: Maxim AI is an end-to-end platform for agent simulation, evaluation, tracing, prompt experiments, human review, and production quality monitoring. Docs

tools.name: Freeplay
tools.description: Freeplay is an AI product development platform that combines prompt management, testing, evaluation, observability, and human review over production data. Docs

tools.name: Parea
tools.description: Parea is an LLM engineering platform with open SDKs for tracing, experiments, evaluations, prompt management, and production monitoring. Docs

tools.name: Traceloop
tools.description: Traceloop is a managed LLM observability platform built around OpenTelemetry instrumentation, with traces, dashboards, evaluations, alerts, and enterprise deployment options. Docs

tools.name: Lunary
tools.description: Lunary is a hosted toolkit for LLM observability, prompt management, user feedback, analytics, evaluations, and team collaboration, with Python and JavaScript client SDKs. Docs

tools.name: Agenta
tools.description: Agenta is an open-source LLMOps platform for prompt versioning, experiments, automatic and human evaluation, tracing, and production observability. Docs

tools.name: PostHog AI Observability
tools.description: PostHog AI Observability captures generations, traces, sessions, token usage, cost, latency, and errors as product analytics events that can be correlated with user behavior and session replay. Docs

tools.name: Arize Phoenix
tools.description: Arize Phoenix is an open-source, OpenTelemetry-based observability and evaluation platform for LLM applications and agents, with trace exploration, datasets, experiments, and evaluators. Docs

tools.name: OpenLIT
tools.description: OpenLIT is an open-source, OpenTelemetry-native AI engineering platform that auto-instruments LLMs, agents, vector databases, and GPUs and provides traces, metrics, evaluations, and dashboards. Docs

tools.name: MLflow Tracing
tools.description: MLflow Tracing is an open-source, OpenTelemetry-compatible tracing system for LLM applications and agents with automatic framework integrations, custom spans, trace search, and self-hosted storage. Docs

tools.name: Pydantic Logfire
tools.description: Pydantic Logfire is an OpenTelemetry-based observability platform with open SDKs and LLM panels for conversations, tool calls, token usage, cost, latency, errors, logs, and application traces. Docs

tools.name: Langtrace
tools.description: Langtrace is an open-source LLM observability project whose OpenTelemetry-based SDKs collect traces, usage, latency, costs, and evaluation signals for export to Langtrace or another compatible backend. Docs

tools.name: SigNoz
tools.description: SigNoz is an open-source, OpenTelemetry-native observability backend that can visualize LLM and agent traces, logs, metrics, token usage, latency, and custom alerts alongside application telemetry. Docs

tools.name: OpenObserve
tools.description: OpenObserve is an open-source observability backend for logs, metrics, and traces that accepts OTLP data and supports LLM dashboards, cost attribution, trace search, and alerts. Docs

tools.name: Jaeger
tools.description: Jaeger is a CNCF distributed-tracing backend that stores and visualizes OpenTelemetry traces, including GenAI spans when an LLM-specific instrumentation library supplies the attributes. Docs

tools.name: Grafana Tempo
tools.description: Grafana Tempo is an open-source distributed-tracing backend for OTLP and other trace formats that can store LLM and agent traces and correlate them with Grafana logs and metrics. Docs

tools.name: OpenTelemetry
tools.description: OpenTelemetry is a vendor-neutral specification and ecosystem of APIs, SDKs, and tools for generating, processing, and exporting traces, metrics, and logs. Docs

tools.name: OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions
tools.description: OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions define common attributes, events, metrics, and span structures for model calls, token usage, prompts, responses, agents, tools, and retrieval operations. Registry

tools.name: OpenInference
tools.description: OpenInference is an open specification and collection of OpenTelemetry instrumentation packages for tracing LLM applications, agents, retrieval systems, and model providers. Docs

tools.name: OpenLLMetry
tools.description: OpenLLMetry is Traceloop's open-source collection of OpenTelemetry instrumentations for LLM providers, vector databases, and agent frameworks, designed to export to any compatible backend.

tools.name: OpenTelemetry Protocol (OTLP)
tools.description: OpenTelemetry Protocol (OTLP) is the standard wire protocol for transmitting OpenTelemetry traces, metrics, and logs between SDKs, collectors, and observability backends.

tools.name: OpenTelemetry Collector
tools.description: OpenTelemetry Collector is a vendor-neutral service for receiving, processing, redacting, sampling, and exporting telemetry, including sensitive GenAI traces. Docs

tools.name: W3C Trace Context
tools.description: W3C Trace Context is the web standard for propagating trace identifiers across process and service boundaries through traceparent and tracestate headers.

tools.name: Portkey
tools.description: Portkey is an open-source AI gateway with a commercial control plane for multi-provider routing, retries, caching, budgets, guardrails, request logs, and observability. Docs

tools.name: LiteLLM
tools.description: LiteLLM is an open-source Python SDK and proxy that exposes a unified API across model providers and supports routing, fallbacks, rate limits, budgets, spend tracking, and logging callbacks. Docs

tools.name: Kong AI Gateway
tools.description: Kong AI Gateway extends Kong's API gateway with model-provider routing, authentication, rate limiting, semantic controls, observability plugins, and enterprise governance. Docs

tools.name: Envoy AI Gateway
tools.description: Envoy AI Gateway is an open-source project built on Envoy Gateway for routing generative-AI traffic with provider-independent APIs, policy, usage accounting, and Kubernetes integration.

tools.name: Cloudflare AI Gateway
tools.description: Cloudflare AI Gateway is a managed proxy for model-provider requests with analytics, logging, caching, rate limiting, retries, and dynamic routing on Cloudflare's network.

tools.name: Vercel AI Gateway
tools.description: Vercel AI Gateway is a managed endpoint for accessing and routing across models with provider failover, usage visibility, budgets, and integration with the Vercel AI SDK. Docs

tools.name: TrueFoundry AI Gateway
tools.description: TrueFoundry AI Gateway is an enterprise gateway for model and MCP access with routing, budgets, guardrails, identity-aware controls, audit logs, and self-hosted deployment options. Docs

tools.name: Gloo AI Gateway
tools.description: Gloo AI Gateway is Solo.io's Envoy-based gateway for model routing, prompt guards, rate limits, failover, telemetry, and Kubernetes-native policy, with open-source components and enterprise features.

tools.name: Bifrost
tools.description: Bifrost is an open-source Go gateway from Maxim AI that provides a unified model API, routing, fallbacks, caching, budgets, usage logs, Prometheus metrics, and OpenTelemetry export.

tools.name: OpenRouter
tools.description: OpenRouter is a managed unified API and routing service for multiple model providers with usage accounting, provider selection, fallbacks, and optional trace broadcasting. Docs

tools.name: Keywords AI
tools.description: Keywords AI is a managed AI gateway and developer platform with multi-provider routing, retries, caching, rate limits, request logs, cost analytics, and evaluations. Docs

tools.name: Traefik Hub AI Gateway
tools.description: Traefik Hub AI Gateway extends Traefik's API management layer with model routing, authentication, rate limiting, token controls, observability, and governance for LLM and agent traffic.

tools.name: DeepEval
tools.category: Online Quality Evaluation and Feedback Monitoring
tools.description: DeepEval is an open-source LLM evaluation framework that can score application outputs and traces with reusable metrics in development, CI, and production monitoring workflows. Docs

tools.name: Evidently
tools.category: Online Quality Evaluation and Feedback Monitoring
tools.description: Evidently is an open-source evaluation and monitoring framework with a managed cloud for LLM judges, text and tabular metrics, test suites, dashboards, and live quality monitoring. Docs

tools.name: Patronus AI
tools.category: Online Quality Evaluation and Feedback Monitoring
tools.description: Patronus AI is an evaluation and monitoring platform for scoring LLM and agent interactions with built-in, custom, and proprietary evaluators, production traces, analytics, and alerts. Docs

tools.name: Openlayer
tools.category: Online Quality Evaluation and Feedback Monitoring
tools.description: Openlayer is an AI quality platform for tests, CI checks, production monitoring, alerts, version comparisons, and governance across generative and predictive systems. Docs

tools.name: Fiddler
tools.category: Online Quality Evaluation and Feedback Monitoring
tools.description: Fiddler is an enterprise AI observability platform for monitoring model and LLM performance, drift, explanations, safety, and quality signals in production.

tools.name: Arthur AI
tools.category: Online Quality Evaluation and Feedback Monitoring
tools.description: Arthur AI is an enterprise monitoring platform for model performance, explainability, drift, bias, and LLM quality and safety checks across production AI systems.

tools.name: Giskard Hub
tools.category: Online Quality Evaluation and Feedback Monitoring
tools.description: Giskard Hub is a commercial testing and monitoring platform built alongside the open-source Giskard library, with automated evaluations, vulnerability scans, continuous testing, and reporting. GitHub

tools.name: TruLens
tools.category: Online Quality Evaluation and Feedback Monitoring
tools.description: TruLens is an open-source library for instrumenting and evaluating LLM applications with feedback functions, trace records, dashboards, and production-oriented evaluation workflows. Docs

tools.name: Ragas
tools.category: Online Quality Evaluation and Feedback Monitoring
tools.description: Ragas is an open-source evaluation library for LLM applications that supplies reusable RAG and agent metrics and can score traced or logged interactions through integrations. Docs

tools.name: Qualifire
tools.category: Online Quality Evaluation and Feedback Monitoring
tools.description: Qualifire is a runtime quality and safety platform that evaluates LLM inputs and outputs, applies policy, records incidents, and exposes monitoring and analytics for production applications.

tools.name: Databricks MLflow Production Monitoring
tools.category: Online Quality Evaluation and Feedback Monitoring
tools.description: Databricks MLflow Production Monitoring continuously runs registered code-based or model-based scorers over sampled MLflow traces and attaches the results as feedback for analysis.

tools.name: Cleanlab TLM
tools.category: Online Quality Evaluation and Feedback Monitoring
tools.description: Cleanlab TLM is an API and platform that adds trustworthiness scores and explanations to LLM responses for filtering, routing, and monitoring uncertain outputs. Docs

tools.name: AgentOps
tools.description: AgentOps is an open-source SDK and service for recording agent sessions, tool calls, model calls, errors, costs, and replayable execution timelines across agent frameworks. Docs

tools.name: AgentNeo
tools.description: AgentNeo is an open-source Python SDK and self-hosted dashboard for tracing agents, LLM calls, tools, costs, execution time, and multi-agent graphs, with evaluation support. Docs

tools.name: RagaAI Catalyst
tools.description: RagaAI Catalyst is an agent testing and observability platform with trace management, execution graphs, evaluations, prompt and dataset management, guardrails, and production analytics. Docs

tools.name: OpenAI Agents SDK Tracing
tools.description: OpenAI Agents SDK Tracing records agent runs, model generations, tool calls, handoffs, guardrails, and custom spans and can send them to OpenAI's Traces dashboard or custom processors.

tools.name: CrewAI AMP
tools.description: CrewAI AMP is CrewAI's managed platform for tracing Crews and Flows, including agent decisions, task timelines, tools, LLM calls, token usage, costs, errors, logs, and performance analytics.

tools.name: LangGraph Platform
tools.description: LangGraph Platform is a managed runtime for stateful agents with deployment, thread and run inspection, time-travel debugging, streaming, and integrated LangSmith tracing. Docs

tools.name: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Observability
tools.description: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Observability emits OpenTelemetry-compatible metrics, spans, and logs for agent runtimes, tools, gateways, memory, sessions, latency, token use, and errors through Amazon CloudWatch.

tools.name: Google Cloud Agent Observability
tools.description: Google Cloud Agent Observability uses OpenTelemetry GenAI conventions to present agent metrics, topology, logs, token usage, latency, and execution traces across supported Google Cloud agent services.

tools.name: Microsoft Foundry Agent Tracing
tools.description: Microsoft Foundry Agent Tracing captures agent inputs, outputs, tools, retries, latency, and cost with OpenTelemetry and stores traces in Azure Monitor Application Insights.

tools.name: Agentuity
tools.description: Agentuity is an agent cloud with automatic OpenTelemetry tracing, structured logs, session timelines, production evaluations, token and cost attribution, and live deployment debugging.

tools.name: Traccia
tools.description: Traccia is an OpenTelemetry-native SDK and platform for agent tracing, token and cost tracking, registry, policy monitoring, governance evidence, and export to compatible backends. Docs

tools.name: tokencost
tools.category: Cost, Latency, and Inference Performance Monitoring
tools.description: tokencost is an open-source library for counting tokens and estimating request costs across model providers from a maintained pricing table.

tools.name: genai-prices
tools.category: Cost, Latency, and Inference Performance Monitoring
tools.description: genai-prices is an open-source package from Pydantic for calculating generative-model request costs from token and usage metadata, including provider-specific pricing dimensions.

tools.name: vLLM Production Metrics
tools.category: Cost, Latency, and Inference Performance Monitoring
tools.description: vLLM Production Metrics are Prometheus-compatible counters, gauges, and histograms exposed by the vLLM server for requests, queueing, cache use, token throughput, latency, and model execution. Docs

tools.name: NVIDIA DCGM Exporter
tools.category: Cost, Latency, and Inference Performance Monitoring
tools.description: NVIDIA DCGM Exporter exposes GPU health, utilization, memory, power, and interconnect metrics in Prometheus format for monitoring self-hosted inference infrastructure.

tools.name: Prometheus
tools.category: Cost, Latency, and Inference Performance Monitoring
tools.description: Prometheus is an open-source metrics and alerting system commonly used to scrape model servers, gateways, collectors, and GPU exporters and to alert on LLM operational signals. Docs

tools.name: OpenCost
tools.category: Cost, Latency, and Inference Performance Monitoring
tools.description: OpenCost is an open-source specification and implementation for attributing Kubernetes infrastructure costs, including GPU-backed inference workloads, by cluster, namespace, workload, and label.

tools.name: GuideLLM
tools.category: Cost, Latency, and Inference Performance Monitoring
tools.description: GuideLLM is an open-source benchmarking tool from the vLLM project for measuring latency, throughput, concurrency behavior, and saturation limits of LLM serving endpoints.

tools.name: NVIDIA GenAI-Perf
tools.category: Cost, Latency, and Inference Performance Monitoring
tools.description: NVIDIA GenAI-Perf is an open-source command-line tool for measuring generative-model serving metrics such as time to first token, inter-token latency, throughput, and request latency.

tools.name: LLMPerf
tools.category: Cost, Latency, and Inference Performance Monitoring
tools.description: LLMPerf is an open-source Ray project for load-testing LLM APIs and reporting latency, token throughput, request throughput, and correctness checks on returned responses.

tools.name: DeepTeam
tools.category: Security, Compliance, and Runtime Policy Monitoring
tools.description: DeepTeam is an open-source LLM red-teaming framework for probing AI systems with configurable attacks and vulnerability checks covering safety, privacy, security, and agent behavior. Docs

tools.name: Lakera Guard
tools.category: Security, Compliance, and Runtime Policy Monitoring
tools.description: Lakera Guard is a runtime security API for detecting prompt injection, jailbreaks, harmful content, and sensitive data in LLM inputs and outputs, with policy and threat analytics.

tools.name: Cisco AI Defense
tools.category: Security, Compliance, and Runtime Policy Monitoring
tools.description: Cisco AI Defense is an enterprise security platform for discovering AI usage, validating models and applications, inspecting runtime traffic, enforcing policy, and recording security events.

tools.name: Palo Alto Prisma AIRS
tools.category: Security, Compliance, and Runtime Policy Monitoring
tools.description: Palo Alto Prisma AIRS is an AI security platform that monitors and protects prompts, responses, models, data flows, tools, and agents with runtime inspection, policy enforcement, posture management, and red teaming.

tools.name: HiddenLayer AI Runtime Security
tools.category: Security, Compliance, and Runtime Policy Monitoring
tools.description: HiddenLayer AI Runtime Security monitors model inputs, outputs, agent workflows, and tool use to detect prompt attacks, unsafe content, data exposure, and anomalous behavior, with blocking and investigation workflows.

tools.name: SentinelOne Prompt Security
tools.category: Security, Compliance, and Runtime Policy Monitoring
tools.description: SentinelOne Prompt Security provides discovery, real-time governance, data-loss prevention, threat protection, and policy controls across employee AI tools, custom applications, and autonomous agents.

tools.name: Mindgard
tools.category: Security, Compliance, and Runtime Policy Monitoring
tools.description: Mindgard is an AI security testing and runtime platform for discovering AI assets, assessing model and application vulnerabilities, monitoring threats, and integrating findings with security workflows.

tools.name: LLM Guard
tools.category: Security, Compliance, and Runtime Policy Monitoring
tools.description: LLM Guard is an open-source toolkit from Protect AI that scans and sanitizes LLM prompts and responses for injection, secrets, PII, toxicity, malicious URLs, and other configurable risks.

tools.name: Enkrypt AI Guardrails
tools.category: Security, Compliance, and Runtime Policy Monitoring
tools.description: Enkrypt AI Guardrails is a runtime policy layer that approves, modifies, or blocks risky prompts, retrievals, responses, MCP calls, and agent tool actions while recording audit-ready decisions.

tools.name: Speakeasy AI Control Plane
tools.category: Security, Compliance, and Runtime Policy Monitoring
tools.description: Speakeasy AI Control Plane governs agent and MCP access with role-scoped permissions, policy enforcement, and auditable tool-call records.

tools.name: Noma Security
tools.category: Security, Compliance, and Runtime Policy Monitoring
tools.description: Noma Security monitors prompts, responses, tool calls, MCP traffic, and agent-to-agent communication in real time and applies detection, masking, blocking, audit logging, and compliance policies.

tools.name: Cranium
tools.category: Security, Compliance, and Runtime Policy Monitoring
tools.description: Cranium is an AI security and governance platform for discovering models and agents, monitoring drift and data exposure, tracking tool use, enforcing controls, and generating compliance evidence.

tools.name: LlamaFirewall
tools.category: Security, Compliance, and Runtime Policy Monitoring
tools.description: LlamaFirewall is Meta's open-source runtime guardrail framework for agentic systems, combining prompt-injection detection, agent-alignment checks, and code-safety analysis.

tools.name: Google Cloud Model Armor
tools.category: Security, Compliance, and Runtime Policy Monitoring
tools.description: Google Cloud Model Armor screens prompts and responses for prompt injection, jailbreaks, harmful content, malicious URLs, and sensitive data and exposes findings for centralized security operations.

tools.name: Azure AI Content Safety
tools.category: Security, Compliance, and Runtime Policy Monitoring
tools.description: Azure AI Content Safety provides APIs and controls for content classification, prompt-attack detection, groundedness checks, custom categories, blocklists, and monitoring of moderation outcomes.

tools.name: Amazon Bedrock Guardrails
tools.category: Security, Compliance, and Runtime Policy Monitoring
tools.description: Amazon Bedrock Guardrails applies configurable content filters, denied topics, sensitive-information controls, contextual grounding checks, and automated reasoning checks and records interventions for monitoring.

tools.name: Datadog Agent Observability
tools.category: Cloud and APM Suites with LLM Observability
tools.description: Datadog Agent Observability traces LLM and agent workflows and monitors token usage, cost, latency, errors, quality, privacy, and safety alongside Datadog APM, infrastructure, logs, and user-experience telemetry. Docs

tools.name: New Relic AI Monitoring
tools.category: Cloud and APM Suites with LLM Observability
tools.description: New Relic AI Monitoring adds model, token, cost, feedback, prompt-response, tool, and agent trace views to New Relic APM and accepts OpenTelemetry GenAI traces.

tools.name: Sentry AI Monitoring
tools.category: Cloud and APM Suites with LLM Observability
tools.description: Sentry AI Monitoring captures agent runs, LLM calls, tools, handoffs, conversations, tokens, cost, latency, and errors and connects those spans to Sentry's application traces and error context.

tools.name: Dynatrace AI Observability
tools.category: Cloud and APM Suites with LLM Observability
tools.description: Dynatrace AI Observability correlates OpenTelemetry and OpenLLMetry data for models, agents, tools, vector databases, services, infrastructure, token usage, cost, latency, errors, and root-cause analysis.

tools.name: Grafana Cloud AI Observability
tools.category: Cloud and APM Suites with LLM Observability
tools.description: Grafana Cloud AI Observability is an OpenTelemetry-based service for monitoring LLM conversations, agents, quality, cost, tokens, latency, tools, traces, metrics, and logs across the Grafana stack.

tools.name: Elastic LLM and Agentic AI Observability
tools.category: Cloud and APM Suites with LLM Observability
tools.description: Elastic LLM and Agentic AI Observability uses Elastic APM, OpenTelemetry, logs, metrics, traces, and prebuilt dashboards to monitor prompts, responses, model calls, tools, token use, latency, errors, and cost.

tools.name: Honeycomb Agent Timeline
tools.category: Cloud and APM Suites with LLM Observability
tools.description: Honeycomb Agent Timeline renders OpenTelemetry GenAI spans as conversation and multi-agent timelines with model calls, tools, messages, errors, token usage, latency, and related service traces.

tools.name: IBM Instana AI Agent and LLM Observability
tools.category: Cloud and APM Suites with LLM Observability
tools.description: IBM Instana AI Agent and LLM Observability discovers AI components and correlates agent workflows, models, tools, vector databases, quality evaluations, cost, tokens, latency, and infrastructure telemetry.

tools.name: Coralogix AI Center
tools.category: Cloud and APM Suites with LLM Observability
tools.description: Coralogix AI Center ingests OpenTelemetry GenAI traces and provides session exploration, production evaluators, guardrails, cost analytics, security posture, and correlation with application observability data.

tools.name: Amazon CloudWatch GenAI Observability
tools.category: Cloud and APM Suites with LLM Observability
tools.description: Amazon CloudWatch GenAI Observability provides managed views, traces, metrics, logs, quality signals, token usage, latency, and errors for Bedrock, AgentCore, and externally instrumented generative-AI workloads.

tools.name: whylogs
tools.description: whylogs is an open-source library and data-logging standard that creates mergeable statistical profiles for monitoring data quality, drift, and model inputs or outputs without storing raw records.

tools.name: NannyML
tools.description: NannyML is an open-source monitoring library with a commercial cloud for estimating post-deployment model performance, detecting covariate shift, and identifying data-quality changes when targets are delayed or absent.

tools.name: Deepchecks
tools.description: Deepchecks is an open-source testing package with a commercial monitoring platform for data integrity, drift, model performance, validation suites, and alerting across machine-learning systems.

tools.name: Alibi Detect
tools.description: Alibi Detect is an open-source Python library for outlier, adversarial, concept-drift, and data-drift detection on tabular, text, image, and time-series data.

tools.name: Great Expectations
tools.description: Great Expectations is an open-source framework for expressing, validating, documenting, and monitoring data-quality expectations in pipelines that may feed retrieval, evaluation, or model systems.

tools.name: Fairlearn
tools.description: Fairlearn is an open-source Python package for assessing disparities with fairness metrics and for mitigating unfairness in supervised machine-learning models.

tools.name: AI Fairness 360
tools.description: AI Fairness 360 is an open-source toolkit from IBM and LF AI & Data containing fairness metrics, explanations, and bias-mitigation algorithms for datasets and machine-learning models.

tools.name: Literal AI
tools.description: Literal AI was a hosted LLM observability, evaluation, and prompt-management platform that was discontinued on October 31, 2025, with its official migration guide directing users to export data.

tools.name: WhyLabs Platform
tools.description: WhyLabs Platform was a hosted AI observability service whose SaaS access ended in March 2025 after the company discontinued operations; its platform code and the whylogs and LangKit projects remain available.

tools.name: Humanloop
tools.description: Humanloop was a prompt, evaluation, and observability platform that sunset on September 8, 2025 following the team's acquisition by Anthropic.

tools.name: Neptune
tools.description: Neptune was an experiment-tracking platform whose hosted app and API were permanently shut down on March 5, 2026 following its acquisition by OpenAI.

tools.name: TensorZero
tools.description: TensorZero was an open-source LLM gateway, observability, evaluation, and optimization platform whose repository was archived and made read-only on June 12, 2026 after its final June release.

tools.name: TruEra AI Observability Platform
tools.description: TruEra AI Observability Platform provided model and LLM evaluation, monitoring, explainability, and debugging before Snowflake acquired the platform in 2024; the separate open-source TruLens project continues.

tools.name: Robust Intelligence
tools.description: Robust Intelligence was an AI security platform for model validation, red teaming, and runtime protection that Cisco acquired in 2024 and incorporated into Cisco AI Defense and Foundation AI.

tools.name: Aporia
tools.description: Aporia was an AI observability and guardrails platform that Coralogix acquired in December 2024 and integrated into its AI research center and AI observability offering.

tools.name: CalypsoAI
tools.description: CalypsoAI was an AI runtime-security and red-teaming company acquired by F5 in September 2025, with its technology subsequently released through F5 AI Guardrails and F5 AI Red Team.
